newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah ends 1996 on stable note.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah ends 1996 on stable note.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar on Monday, the year's last trading day, dealers said.
They said the dollar-rupiah rate closed at 2,362.0/62.5 on Monday, against an opening of 2,363.0/64.25. It compared with an opening of 2,281.0/83.0 on January 2 this year.
Dealers said there was barely any volume, with trading limited to position squaring and to some customer orders.
Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,361.50/62.50 and 2,363.75/64.25, respectively. One dealer said sentiment on the rupiah stayed firm despite ample liquidity in the money market.

He said offshore operators were still speculating on a band widening by the central bank and some expected it to come in the first quarter of next year. He said this might explain the sustained pressure on dollars.
Swap premiums remained cheap on ample rupiah supply. Overnight swap was at -0.25/par and tom/next at 0.27/0.30.
Overnight dollar deposit rate settled at 7.5 percent after rising to a high of 12.0 percent at midday on tight supply.
Overnight money closed at 7.5 percent after the central bank offered three-day papers (SBIs) at seven percent.
The foreign exchange market will be closed on December 31 and January 1. It will resume trading on January 2.
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention rate by one point to 2,359/2,551 and the conversion rate to 2,359/2,407 on Monday.
Bank Indonesia fixing on December 29, 1995 was 2,286/2,330.
